Find the perfect order of a distinct set of symbols to operate the system at its best!

Depending on the order is the system's performance.
Each symbol can only be present once in the output sequence.

The symbols with their performance properties:
A = yields best performance if not followed by more than one symbol
B = yields best performance if not preceded by symbol A or C
C = yields best performance when not being the last symbol
D = yields best performance when being the first symbol

To find the perfect order of a distinct set of symbols to operate the system at its best, we need to consider the performance properties of each symbol. Since D yields the best performance when being the first symbol, we should start with D. Next, we can add B since it yields the best performance when not preceded by symbol A or C. After B, we can add F since it yields the best performance when not being the last symbol. Finally, we can end with A since it yields the best performance if not followed by more than one symbol. Therefore, the perfect order of the distinct set of symbols is DFBA.
